byte_evidence.method: Parse each attributable input_text JSON payload; unwrap Promise.allSettled fulfilled.value. For shell count decoded exec_command.output UTF-8 bytes; for aide count decoded content text block UTF-8 bytes. Includes aide text headings/fences/line labels as returned retrieval text, excludes JSON/protocol envelopes, bootstrap and local metadata discovery. Captured inputs reviewed but never executed.

notes: Manually interpreted all wrappers: array.map expands to five actual outline calls; for-of expands to four actual read_symbol calls. Eleven symbol names are requested across four batches, not eleven separate calls. Six exec_command calls yield fifteen total nested calls. ALL_TOOLS.filter is local metadata discovery, not another nested tool call.

Guided treatment conforms: after listing/line counts, five larger files receive collapsed outlines with keep_comments=true, including 1451-line hooks.ts. Relevant symbols are then read in batches from model-usage.ts, hooks.ts, observe_events.go and token_events.go. Small README/memory types read directly; token_model_usage.go is read in full after outline. No outline-to-search fallback occurs in this trace.

Every aide call uses explicit absolute file paths inside assigned root. All shell commands start rtk with assigned-root workdir except permitted RTK bootstrap. No other aide operations, global/index search, external roots, prior results, internet, delegation, reference or grader reads observed.

Read-only integrity passes: no changed, unexpected, missing or symlink files. No edits, test calls, failures or retries. Scope assessment uses captured operations and provenance, not filesystem syscall tracing.

Aide content text is attributable; per-operation duration and hook receipts are absent from these returned result objects and remain unknown. Bytes are not model tokens, billing or causal savings. Quality assessment is separate; grades unchanged.

host_event_count_crosscheck.note: Count comparison is boundary evidence only, not one-to-one byte/source proof or unchanged model delivery. Local discovery expressions do not produce nested tool-call receipts. t10/t16 wrapper truncation remains distinct from full host payload counts.
